animationRetargeting: Native wpn attachment and embedded weapon tracks; missing authored helper bones retain their original parent/local transform. Source2 animation graphs/cloth solver are not reproduced.
finishRendering: Native inventory previews resized for browser delivery and bounded wear data; approximate browser compositor using native paint recipes, textures, region masks and palettes. Rare case families are reconstructed; local currency/items are not Steam items.

browserMapDelivery.notes: Same visible source triangle topology; redundant native normals/tangents/secondary UVs removed because browser computes normals and uses only base color. Original collision is untouched. Meshopt uses 16-bit position quantization and 14-bit UV quantization.
